parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Two parallel plate capacitors $C_1$ and $C_2$ are connected to a supply that has a potential difference (p.d.) $V_S$. The capacitors may be connected in series or in parallel.

The supply provides charge $Q_S$ and the plates of the two capacitors acquire charges $Q_1$ and $Q_2$ respectively. The p.d.s across the plates of the capacitors are $V_1$ and $V_2$ respectively.

Complete Table 6.1 to indicate how $Q_S$, $Q_1$ and $Q_2$ relate to each other, and how $V_S$, $V_1$ and $V_2$ relate to each other, for series and parallel connections of the capacitors to the supply.

parts.text:
The capacitor is now connected in parallel with a capacitor of capacitance $180\,\mu\text{F}$ that is initially uncharged.

Determine the total energy, in mJ, now stored in the two capacitors.
